topic: What happens if you stay awake for eleven days?
title: Eleven Days Awake
hook: Could you stay awake for eleven days?

beats.label: 2 DAYS
beats.line: After two days, your eyes won't focus and you can't stop yawning.

beats.label: 4 DAYS
beats.line: By day four, your brain starts to dream while you're still awake.

beats.label: 7 DAYS
beats.line: A week in, your memory slips and simple math feels impossible.

beats.label: 11 DAYS
beats.line: In nineteen sixty-four, Randy Gardner lasted eleven days, slurring every word.

beats.label: 1 NIGHT
beats.line: Then he slept fourteen hours and woke up feeling fine.

end.line: What's the longest you've ever stayed awake?

description: From blurry eyes to waking dreams: what eleven days without sleep did to Randy Gardner. Don't try it.

facts.claim: Randy Gardner stayed awake for 264 hours (about 11 days) in 1964.
facts.source: Stanford Center for Sleep Sciences; Guinness World Records

facts.claim: By about day four he had hallucinations, and memory and concentration problems followed.
facts.source: Ross, J.J. (1965) Neurological findings after prolonged sleep deprivation, Archives of Neurology

facts.claim: By the end his speech was slurred.
He then slept about 14 hours and recovered without lasting harm reported.
